[Wed 2026-05-20 11:46 UTC] Locate the mail transfer agent installed on the system.
I’ll check installed packages, common MTA binaries, and active mail-related services.

arguments.command:
set -e
printf 'Common MTA binaries found:\n'
for b in sendmail postfix qmail-send exim exim4 opensmtpd smtpd msmtp nullmailer; do
  if command -v "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '  %s -> %s\n' "$b" "$(command -v "$b")"; fi
done

printf '\nAlternatives / sendmail provider:\n'
if command -v update-alternatives >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  update-alternatives --query mta 2>/dev/null || true
  update-alternatives --query sendmail 2>/dev/null || true
fi
ls -l /usr/sbin/sendmail /usr/lib/sendmail 2>/dev/null || true

printf '\nMail-related systemd services:\n'
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl list-unit-files --type=service 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'postfix|exim|sendmail|opensmtpd|smtp|qmail|nullmailer|msmtp' || true
fi

printf '\nInstalled mail packages:\n'
if command -v dpkg-query >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}\t${Version}\n' 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '^(postfix|exim4?|sendmail|opensmtpd|qmail|courier-mta|nullmailer|msmtp|ssmtp)\b' || true
elif command -v rpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rpm -qa | grep -Ei '^(postfix|exim|sendmail|opensmtpd|qmail|nullmailer|msmtp|ssmtp)' || true
fi
